confirmed_defects.class: atomic ledger revocation ignored after row capture
confirmed_defects.invariant: PROVINCE.md:14-16: nothing qualifies as moved-to-obsidian without a matching ledger row; quarantine stage 4 must re-derive the receipt before deletion. Fail closed when receipt authority changes mid-check.
schedule: Create fresh fixture git repos, distinct regular .md sources and independent vault copies; write exact source/vault SHA-256 rows into one shared ledger.

Start parallel calls. A fixture-only sha256sum scheduling shim pauses before executing the real sha256sum: first source hash for the verification siblings, second vault hash for quarantine (inside the second receipt check).

Wait until every child reaches its barrier, proving its old row has already been captured. Atomically replace ledger.tsv with a header-only ledger.tmp using os.replace; verify inode and SHA-256 changed.
Release real hashing. The current ledger has zero rows throughout every remaining check and verdict/deletion.
Observe sibling SAFE results and quarantine DELETED results. Fresh sibling calls against the same sources and current ledger return NOT-SAFE.

surfaces.cause: ledger_lines streams a captured row into try_obsidian; the source/vault hashes are accepted without checking whether the authoritative ledger pathname still contains that row.
surfaces.observed_per_fresh_run: 4/4 in-flight calls returned SAFE(moved-to-obsidian), exit 0, after all ledger rows were revoked; 4/4 fresh calls returned NOT-SAFE.
surfaces.expected_under_fail_closed_rule: NOT-SAFE when the authoritative ledger changes/removes the receipt before hashing completes.

surfaces.cause: load_ledger caches rows at process start; try_ledger later authorizes from LEDGER_ROWS with no generation/content revalidation. Evidence names the current ledger path even though its receipt row is gone.
surfaces.observed_per_fresh_run: 4/4 in-flight --fallback calls returned SAFE and VERIFIED(moved-to-obsidian), exit 0, after all ledger rows were revoked; 4/4 fresh calls returned NOT-SAFE.
surfaces.expected_under_fail_closed_rule: NOT-SAFE when the authoritative ledger changes/removes the receipt before hashing completes.

surfaces.cause: second_check stores ledger_row_for output, then hashes the vault and passes from the stored row; no ledger-generation check exists between row capture and rm.
surfaces.observed_per_fresh_run: 4/4 parallel calls emitted stage4-second PASS and RESULT ... DELETED moved-to-obsidian, exit 0, after header-only ledger replacement; originals and quarantine copies were absent afterward.
surfaces.expected_under_fail_closed_rule: ABORTED; retain staged bytes when the receipt is revoked during the second check.

confirmed_defects.impact_limit: This reproducer establishes ignored receipt revocation and unauthorized fixture deletion, not data loss: every independent vault copy survives. Source/vault bytes are not changed or forged by the scheduling shim. It does not claim ordinary simultaneous read-only calls corrupt the ledger.
confirmed_defects.suggested_hardening: Use a coherent ledger generation/fingerprint and refuse on replacement/content drift before SAFE or deletion; coordinate destructive authorization and ledger writers with a lock/generation protocol. Keeping an old open descriptor or old array alone does not establish current receipt authority. No fix was attempted by this red-team seat.
